Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.

2558-4659-7916.description:

When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.

670-1619-3175-4681-6797.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.

670-1619-3175-4681-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-3175-4681-6797.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

2743-6570-7694.description:

At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by The Earth Crystal.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.

Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
1308-5658-6245-6441.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.

If Nardole has at least four counters on it, this combo nets infinite {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells, and you may target any other creature using Chakram Retriever's trigger.

Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

If opponents control three or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.

2152-3090-4691.description:

During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.

Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.

Resolve the Doomed Traveler trigger, creating a creature token.

Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Doomed Traveler from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.

2034-2775-2850-5154.notablePrerequisites: Lingering Tormentor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.

1409-2564-4231-4772.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.

Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.

1737-4050-4853-5004.description:

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding one mana of any color.
When Cathodion dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.

926-1462.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Aura Thief.
